notes: Colour photograph cropped through the map: no frame rule anywhere, and the paper (with map ink) runs to all four page edges with no background visible (checked at every corner and mid-side), so the polygon is the whole page (README rule 5). Floating blocks are cut out as holes (rule 4): (1) the title and legend block 'CITY & COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO / USE OF PROPERTY / ZONE MAP / LEGEND' with its six swatches in the top-left corner (ink x 68-840, y 130-617), stepped at y 440 because the swatch column starts left of the title and runs right of it; it sits on plain paper, the nearest map ink (hatched blocks) starts at x ~1040; (2) the 'SECTION 12' circle (ink x ~4537-4695, y ~83-243). The circle is printed in a tight gap between map ink: a diagonal street line up-left (10-25 px away), the apex of a street triangle down-left (only ~12 px from the circle at y ~185), a street line at x ~4702 to the right from y ~195, and block numbers 5646 / 5647 just below. All of that stays map, so the hole is a 13-point outline run through the paper gap, about halfway between the circle and the street ink (5-8 px from each where tightest). No compass rose, scale bar or cross-reference note on this sheet. Place names (BALBOA PARK, AMAZON RESERVOIR SITE, CITY PROPERTY, HOLLY PARK, ST MARY'S PLAYGROUND), the hospital cross symbol and street names stay map.
